svg.title: HyperWeave — sweep
svg.desc: One continuous diagonal sweep, ink to ion cyan, flowing across the whole form as a single event. Core lands on the sweep's terminal hue. The Gemini move.

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: One gradient, one direction, one story: energy entering at the ink corner and leaving at the cyan corner.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: Two stops only, 45-degree userSpace sweep spanning the full glyph so the color travels THROUGH the form instead of banding across it; the core takes the end-stop so it reads as where the sweep resolves.
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: A sweep is directional, so the mark now has a corner hierarchy the symmetric geometry didn't ask for — accepted, because that implied motion is the identity: flow through the weave.
hw:reasoning.hw:spatial-notes: 64x64, bilateral about (32,32); cushion cardinals +/-29; core anchored at center. Static and filter-free by set doctrine: identity first, motion is a layer added after selection.
